decision: GENERIC PRODUCT DEFECT — preserved as specimen (diagnosis corrected; see correction)
harness_behavior: Correct fail-closed: REQUIRED outcome==SUCCEEDED; got failed_output_contract (Decision Gate 0.00); wrote FAIL and exited 1. Zero interventions.

diagnosis.signature: ~20 'Empty LLM response — returning empty dict' during gap analysis; structured JSON extraction failed; Decision Gate aborted at 0.00 immediately after gap_analysis.
diagnosis.reproduced_post_failure: json_schema-dialect structured calls against the local qwen3-4b-2507 returned empty content 3/4 times in a post-failure probe battery (plain completions healthy: strict probe 'alive', 2 completion tokens).
diagnosis.classification: INVALID ATTEMPT — the certified model's serving state degraded for structured calls during the run window; the frozen run conditions did not hold through the attempt. LM Studio server had been up ~2 days since the Case-2D-era restart; the first Case-3 attempt already showed 19 early empties (recorded as diagnostics) before recovering.
diagnosis.preflight_weakness_admitted: The certified_model gate checked a single non-empty completion — it cannot detect structured-call degradation. Strengthened for the next attempt: repeated strict-completion battery + repeated json_schema structured battery.
diagnosis.known_contributing_product_weakness: Degraded LLM responses fail OPEN to empty dicts (recorded since Case 2 postmortems, deliberately not fixed mid-qualification). Where the empties land determines whether a run survives; the harness's outcome requirement fails closed regardless.

corrective_action: Environment restore only (no production change): restart LM Studio server (--bind 0.0.0.0), reload qwen3-4b-2507 per the registry hardware notes (ctx 8192, gpu max, identifier), verify with the strengthened probe batteries, fresh research state, same sealed harness, new attempt (3C).
specimen: evidence/case3_result.json (overwritten by this attempt — harness writes a single path)

diagnosis_correction.original_claim: Transient serving-state degradation during the run window (environment).
diagnosis_correction.disproof: A full LM Studio server restart plus model reload did NOT change the behavior: structured json_schema calls still returned empty content 4/8 times post-restore. A degradation window would have cleared.
diagnosis_correction.corrected_diagnosis: Chronic, stochastic empty-content returns on structured (json_schema-dialect) calls from the local certified model, at a reproduced 40-75% rate. Historical logs show the SAME signature in every successful run (Case 2D: ~19 empties; Case 3 first attempt: ~19 empties) — runs succeeded when empties missed load-bearing calls. In 3B the empties hit gap-quality scoring; the Decision Gate correctly aborted at 0.00. Plain completions are unaffected (strict probes 4/4 'alive' throughout).
diagnosis_correction.taxonomy_classification: GENERIC PRODUCT DEFECT per the frozen taxonomy: a common-path bug (empty LLM content fails open to an empty dict, making load-bearing stochastic calls fragile), not a capability-specific design need and not an environment violation — the frozen conditions included this model exactly as it behaves.
diagnosis_correction.prescribed_path: Per the frozen taxonomy: preserve attempt; smallest generic fix; re-freeze (Q0 -> Q1); new attempt. The smallest generic fix is a bounded retry-on-empty in the provider's structured_output path — capability-independent, provider-level, directly targets the reproduced failure mode.
